title: Astronomer Dag Run Duration p95
app: Astronomer (managed Airflow) deployment logs and metrics via the Astro API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=astronomer:dag state="success"
| eval dur_s=round(duration/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by dag_id
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile run duration for each DAG in Astronomer and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Astronomer DAGs by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Astronomer timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest DAGs with their owners.
visualization: Table of DAG by p95 run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Astronomer so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
